text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of the summer training camp. 
As a finishing touch, I was checking 
Vivlos's all-out running form—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The true strength she had held back due to 
physical concerns finally explodes— Vivlos 
has undeniably grown over this summer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I dropped the treats...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Hyaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis! Did you see how I just ran?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. You're amazing, Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised... ...You've grown so 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, right, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Do you think so too, Trainie?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis. I'm definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho... Look forward to it, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...How strange, I—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—To think her running would overlap with 
"that person's"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, Vivlos gave 
it her all without pushing herself past 
her limits.
choice_data_list: Just one final check: how are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Neither my tummy nor my throat feel weird 
at all. I feel super great!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Trainy, thank you so, so much!
choice_data_list: I haven't done anything to be thanked for.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No. It's because you thought about me so 
much, Trainy, that I was able to do my 
best.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So…… Thank you after all♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'll win the Shion Stakes, win 
the Shuka Sho, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the Tiara route is over, the Senior 
Class begins right away. In March, that 
race is held—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's it~~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I'm focusing on the Tiara route right 
now, so I'm looking a bit elsewhere at the 
moment, but..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I made up my mind to give both my all, 
after all!
choice_data_list:
First, let's do our best in the Shion 
Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Preparations for the Shuka Sho prelude— 
the Shion Stakes—are complete."
